heating.sql: SELECT s.StoreyName AS Storey, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCSPACEHEATER') AS SpaceHeaters, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCPIPESEGMENT') AS PipeSegments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCPIPEFITTING') AS PipeFittings, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.Category = 'IFCVALVE') AS Valves FROM EntityText e JOIN StoreyOfElement s ON s.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex GROUP BY s.StoreyName ORDER BY s.StoreyName

total.aggregates: sum(SpaceHeaters) as SpaceHeaters, sum(PipeSegments) as PipeSegments, sum(PipeFittings) as PipeFittings, sum(Valves) as Valves
